scope: Proposed isolated Windows library qualification, not Hengshi feature implementation or stack adoption
steps: Require applicable founder authorization before creating or installing into the new research environment; independently review this proposal first.
Recheck frozen inputs, current native Python/pip identity, free disk and exact candidate hashes; refuse an existing target or incompatible host.
Use native Python venv --without-pip for the new target. Existing pip is the recorded bootstrap tool, not a newly selected production toolchain.
Download only the 43 exact hashed binary wheels with --require-hashes --only-binary=:all: --no-deps --no-cache-dir into the dedicated wheelhouse; enforce budget before offline installation.

Use existing pip --python <new-environment-python> with --no-index --find-links <wheelhouse> --require-hashes --only-binary=:all: --no-deps --no-cache-dir to install only into that new environment. No source build or dependency re-resolution.
Run pip check and the synthetic public-library probes below with bytecode disabled, no application import or server/listener and no real tokens, accounts or data.
Measure retained output size and verify protected inputs unchanged; stop on failure. Preserve errors rather than reinterpret or silently retry. Deletion needs separate approval.

probes.cases: Locally generated RSA key: valid RS256 token with explicit algorithm, issuer and audience succeeds; wrong key, wrong audience, expired token and disallowed algorithm fail. No Entra token or live JWKS.
probes.limit: Primitive coupling only; no OIDC/PKCE/nonce discovery client, identity grant or Hengshi session enforcement.

probes.cases: Strict integer plus extra-forbid request accepts a valid integer and rejects coercible text/unknown fields; explicit response model returns expected UTC serialization.
probes.limit: In-process synthetic library fixture, no actual Hengshi route, socket, security or production serialization coverage.

probes.cases: In-memory SQLite transaction rollback leaves no committed row after an intentional failure; subsequent transaction remains usable.
probes.limit: No PostgreSQL/Psycopg persistence, network pool or concurrency assurance.

probes.cases: Public offline PostgreSQL dialect context emits DDL for a synthetic table without a database connection.
probes.limit: No migration run, real schema or rollback exercise.

probes.cases: Import public pq API; record implementation/build/runtime libpq versions without connecting.
probes.limit: Native import only, no database protocol, authentication or driver transaction assurance.

probes.cases: Synthetic short password verifies; incorrect password fails; 73-byte input raises the version's documented length error.
probes.limit: No production password policy, emergency access or password storage adoption.

probes.cases: Load a synthetic ASGI application configuration without running or binding the server.
probes.limit: No actual listener, websocket, shutdown, load or deployment proof.

probes.cases: Run an actual async synthetic test through the installed plugin and report package identities and failures.
probes.limit: Test tooling coupling only, not application coverage.

remaining: Whole-graph newest-compatible recheck, production tools/platform selection and reproducible final lock
Supported release channel, provenance/attestations, full licence and advisory review
Maintained OIDC/PKCE adapter selection and its complete extra graph
Approved actual identity/API/database/authorization/recovery behavior and named environment qualification
Independent results review and integrated/founder acceptance; no dependency adoption implied
